name: UACC-USL-ANT-HG
title: SuperLink High-Gain Antenna
summary: IP67 outdoor high-gain omni antenna (7 dBi SuperLink 860-930 MHz + BT) to extend SuperLink range to 5 km LOS.

requires: UniFi SuperLink gateway with RP-SMA antenna port

extra.connector: RP-N female; cable RP-SMA male to RP-N male, 1 m

gotchas: Passive antenna only - requires a UniFi SuperLink gateway.
Only a 1 m cable - the SuperLink gateway must be close to the mast.
5 km is line-of-sight best case; certifications list CE only.
best_for: extending SuperLink sensors across large properties
